params.body:
A set of changes for members and a few site-wide fixes, each checked locally (screenshots logged out and logged in as a local test reader).

**For members (logged in)**
- **Menu:** "Services" and "Pricing" make way for **Your plan**, which leads to the account page. Both are the sales half of the site and say much the same thing to someone who already has a plan.
- **Reading room:**
  - no rule under the welcome;
  - the newest post and six more instead of the whole archive, with "All posts →";
  - the current report in the same band as on the public home page.
- **Contact:**
  - says which plan the member is on;
  - fills in name and email;
  - offers topics about the plan ("A question about my plan", "Changing my plan");
  - links to Your plan and the reports.

**Site-wide**
- **"How we read" scroll scene:** it pins below the 96px header instead of under it, so the heading and the first step no longer slide behind the menu. The scene is a quarter shorter (320vh).
- **Trend graph:** the trend layer sits at y 68 instead of 76. It floated a floor too high above the patterns.
- **Footer:** the two page columns are as wide as their words, closer together, and start on the column line like Sectors.
- **Mails:** the header carries the full logo with "Decoding youth culture", as a PNG (`brand/gentells-logo-full@2x.png`, rendered from the SVG) because mail clients strip SVG.
- **Sign-in card:** white with a hairline on the green-tinted ground, instead of warm stone on cool green.

Tests: 345 passing.
params.title: Members: Your plan, a plan-aware contact page, a shorter reading room; footer, mail logo, scroll scene
